## About
Westlake Hills Dentistry is Dr. Vincent Ho's practice on Capital of Texas Highway in West Lake Hills. Dr. Ho and his team provide quality, personalized care for the whole family, from cleanings and fillings to crowns, implants and Invisalign.
With extensive training in implants and cosmetic dentistry, Dr. Ho is able to keep your dental care under one roof. Debbie assists chairside, Wendy is our registered dental hygienist, and Diane, our office manager, helps with scheduling, payments and insurance questions.
Patients have given us a 4.9 rating across 224 Google reviews. One longtime patient described Dr. Ho as compassionate, attentive, candid and intelligent.

## Services
- Same day CEREC crowns: Crowns designed and made in the office so you can often finish in one visit instead of waiting on a lab.
- Dental implant in a single visit: For qualified patients, a tooth can be removed, a dental implant placed, and you leave with a natural-looking temporary crown in a single visit.
- Invisalign: Clear aligners for teens and adults who want straighter teeth without metal braces.
- Root canal therapy: Repairs a damaged tooth and protects it from further damage or infection.
- Teeth whitening: Dr. Ho uses a prescription strength whitening solution to get teeth their whitest.
- Wisdom teeth: One reviewer had all four wisdom teeth extracted here and said Dr. Ho and Debbie did a great job.
- Botox for TMJ pain relief: Botox is available for esthetic use and for relief of TMJ pain.
- Implant consultations: Talk with Dr. Ho about whether an implant is right for you, at no charge. (Free)

## FAQ
Q: Who can help with insurance questions?
A: Diane, our office manager, assists patients with scheduling, payments and insurance questions and claims.

Q: Are you open later on any day?
A: Wednesday is our later day, from 10 AM to 6 PM. We're closed Friday through Sunday.

Q: Can I come in for a second opinion?
A: Yes. Second opinions are free, so you can bring your questions and get a clear answer from Dr. Ho.

And then we found Westlake Hills Dentistry. I highly recommend you compare treatment plan with different offices to see how they charge you for the same procedure.

We have had other dentists quoting us ridiculous amounts for basic fillings. A few dental offices slap on mandatory add-ons like isov $10 and desensitizers $30 for each usage and operation,  which aren’t covered by insurance. And some even started pushing protection plans on their own fillings 😂. But Dr. Ho keeps it straight and just charges you for the operations. Everything else is just overhead. He gives you a bite block and some sedation and he’s ready to go. He’s also trained at UCSF 👀. I haven’t had to redo any fillings he’s done but I can’t say the same for previous dentists.

I also had all four wisdom teeth extracted here and Dr. Ho charged me half of what other dental offices quoted me for. He has a 3D X-ray that was included in my first visit and that was all he needed to operate on my teeth while other offices were going to charge me $210 for a CT scan. Others also were quoting $250 just for sedation. Though I’m at the age of peak bone density, Dr. Ho and Debbie did a great job extracting and stitching me up! I had almost no swelling with the wound dressing he performed after each extraction. In two days, I was playing sports again 🙃.

My wife had a tooth that was bothering her for a while. One office said she needed a root canal, one office said she needed a crown, and one said she needed a filling. None of these treatments would have been covered by insurance as they were preventative. And Dr. Ho said it looked fine in the imagery but just sensitive from grinding so she got Invisalign and that tooth has been fine since then. He saved us thousands from a tooth that just needed some love 🤭.

My dental hygienist Wendy is amazing and does a great job with cleaning each time. No pain at all and easy to talk to. And Dr. Ho checks on the cleaning as well.

Lastly, Diane, the office manager, is the champ and a gem. She is a sweet and kind lady who answers your calls, messages/emails you back, keeps the numbers straight for all the treatment plans, and deals with insurances and billing. She basically handles all the crap with the most grace! I’ve never received additional charges after I paid in this office unlike some other offices where I would get another $150 for no reason.

This is the kind of dental office we trust completely and we would confidently bring our future kids here 👶🏻" (Bryan, 5/5)
